BMI: This subset of samples was selected based on the following clinical criteria: a breast volume of more than 800 mL, no previous case nor familial history of breast or ovarian cancer, nonsmoker, no diabetes mellitus, and a body mass index below 30.
anatomic_site_tumor: All specimens were collected from women with primary breast cancer, who underwent tumor resection between 1991 and 2004.
disease_state: Two samples sets of breast cancer tissues (set 1: 21 samples and set 2: 24 samples) were analyzed by RNA-sequencing and MS analyses.
material_type: Two samples sets of breast cancer tissues (set 1: 21 samples and set 2: 24 samples) were analyzed by RNA-sequencing and MS analyses.
sample_source: All tissues were collected from Lund University Hospital and affiliated clinics located in the Skåne region.
sex: All specimens were collected from women with primary breast cancer, who underwent tumor resection between 1991 and 2004.
species: MS spectra were searched using an Andromeda built-in search engine against the Uniprot-Swissprot human proteome database (version download 2017.06.12).
